_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Passage (Quest)#002.src: My dad said I can't let any strangers through this passage!
The Passage (Quest)#002.dst: 我爸說了，我不能讓任何陌生人通過這條通道！
The Passage (Quest)#002.speaker: Wirt

The Passage (Quest)#003.src: If you want access, talk to him, he's the recruiter of the town! His name is Ildan. He's just southwest of here.
The Passage (Quest)#003.dst: 你要想過去，去找他談。他是鎮上的招募官！他叫 Ildan，就在這裡的西南邊。
The Passage (Quest)#003.speaker: Wirt

The Passage (Quest)#004.src: Find Ildan in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and ask to be a member of the town
The Passage (Quest)#004.dst: 在 {p} 的 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 找到 Ildan，請求成為鎮上的一員

The Passage (Quest)#005.src: Oh! So you want to become a member of this town?
The Passage (Quest)#005.dst: 哦！所以你想成為這個鎮的一員？
The Passage (Quest)#005.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#006.src: You will have to help us first, of course!
The Passage (Quest)#006.dst: 那當然得先幫我們一個忙！
The Passage (Quest)#006.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#007.src: I'm sure you've noticed, but there is a tribe camp not too far from here.
The Passage (Quest)#007.dst: 你應該注意到了，離這裡不遠有個部落營地。
The Passage (Quest)#007.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#008.src: They used to have a powerful chief, but he eventually died in battle.
The Passage (Quest)#008.dst: 他們以前有位很強的酋長，後來戰死了。
The Passage (Quest)#008.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#009.src: The tribe couldn't bear the fact that he was dead. They performed some unethical necromancy spell on him.
The Passage (Quest)#009.dst: 部落無法接受他的死，於是對他施了某種不該碰的死靈術。
The Passage (Quest)#009.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#010.src: They quickly realized that is was a bad idea, so they locked him in a tomb.
The Passage (Quest)#010.dst: 他們很快就發現這是個爛主意，所以把他鎖進了一座墓穴。
The Passage (Quest)#010.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#011.src: He keeps reviving his minions and it's causing quite some problems to our army.
The Passage (Quest)#011.dst: 他不斷把手下復活，給我們的軍隊帶來不少麻煩。
The Passage (Quest)#011.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#012.src: You can access the tomb from a sacrificial shrine, I've heard, but I'm not sure how. There are probably hints nearby the shrine.
The Passage (Quest)#012.dst: 我聽說可以從一座獻祭神壇進入那座墓穴，但我不確定怎麼進。神壇附近應該會有提示。
The Passage (Quest)#012.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#013.src: Bring me back [{~} Antic Bead] as a proof of its death, and I will let you become a citizen.
The Passage (Quest)#013.dst: 把 [{~} 古怪珠子] 帶回來給我當作牠已死的憑證，我就讓你成為鎮民。
The Passage (Quest)#013.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#014.src: I've marked the direction to the shrine in your book. Remember, there should be hints right nearby the shrine. Good luck.
The Passage (Quest)#014.dst: 我把神壇的方向標在你的書上了。記住，提示就在神壇附近。祝你好運。
The Passage (Quest)#014.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#015.src: Search for clues near [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring back [{~} Antic Bead] to Ildan.
The Passage (Quest)#015.dst: 在 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 附近尋找線索，並把 [{~4} 古怪珠子] 帶回給 Ildan。

The Passage (Quest)#016.dst: 厲害！你把珠子拿到手了！
The Passage (Quest)#016.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#017.src: Well, welcome to this town, adventurer! You are now officially a citizen.
The Passage (Quest)#017.dst: 那麼，歡迎來到這個鎮，冒險者！你正式成為鎮民了。
The Passage (Quest)#017.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#018.src: Oh, but before you go! I do have a few things to say. First, about the beads here.
The Passage (Quest)#018.dst: 哦，不過在你走之前！我還有幾件事要說。第一，關於這裡的珠子。
The Passage (Quest)#018.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#019.src: The tribesmen accept these as currency, so if you collect enough, I've heard they can offer you powerful masks.
The Passage (Quest)#019.dst: 部落的人把這些當貨幣用，所以你要是收集得夠多，聽說他們可以給你強力的面具。
The Passage (Quest)#019.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#020.src: Second, about the shrine. Now, this is just a rumor, but apparently that tomb is not unique.
The Passage (Quest)#020.dst: 第二，關於那座神壇。這只是傳聞，但那座墓穴似乎不是唯一的一座。
The Passage (Quest)#020.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#021.src: There are supposed to be a bunch of these altars scattered around the province, even in Gavel too!
The Passage (Quest)#021.dst: 據說這種祭壇散布在整個行省，連 Gavel 那邊都有！
The Passage (Quest)#021.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#022.src: If true, you should look for them. While the fights will be tough, I would imagine great rewards could be gotten from them!
The Passage (Quest)#022.dst: 如果是真的，你應該去找找看。那些戰鬥會很硬，但我猜報酬也會很可觀！
The Passage (Quest)#022.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#023.src: Anyway, I've talked enough. I'm proud to have such a powerful fighter join our town! I wish you luck, friend!
The Passage (Quest)#023.dst: 好了，我話說夠多了。有你這樣的強者加入我們鎮，我很驕傲！祝你好運，朋友！
The Passage (Quest)#023.speaker: Ildan
